title: Verified fixed-coin-tape isolation for pinned NP verifier queries
claims: FixedCoinTapeQueryIsolation takes explicit fixed-length Boolean tapes, generates queries in polynomial time, and proves a one-eighth isolation fraction for every source yes-input.
Any accepted witness of a generated query belongs to the original finite set of bounded NP witnesses, including at all tape values.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
